channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2013-2729 — Adobe Reader and Acrobat
item.description: Threat Signal 73. Integer overflow vulnerability in Adobe Reader and Acrobat allows attackers to execute remote code.

item.title: CVE-2022-26318 — WatchGuard Firebox and XTM Appliances
item.description: Threat Signal 76. On WatchGuard Firebox and XTM appliances, an unauthenticated user can execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2013-4810 — Hewlett Packard (HP) ProCurve Manager (PCM), PCM+, Identity Driven Manager (IDM), and Application Lifecycle Management
item.description: Threat Signal 76. HP ProCurve Manager (PCM), PCM+, Identity Driven Manager (IDM), and Application Lifecycle Management allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a marshalled object to (1) EJBInvokerServlet or (2) JMXInvokerServlet.

item.title: CVE-2017-6077 — NETGEAR Wireless Router DGN2200
item.description: Threat Signal 74. NETGEAR DGN2200 wireless routers contain a vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2020-2021 — Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains a vulnerability in SAML which allows an attacker to bypass authentication.

item.title: CVE-2018-0125 — Cisco VPN Routers
item.description: Threat Signal 71. A vulnerability in the web interface of the Cisco VPN Routers could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary code as root and gain full control of an affected system.

item.title: CVE-2018-20753 — Kaseya Virtual System/Server Administrator (VSA)
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Kaseya VSA RMM allows unprivileged remote attackers to execute PowerShell payloads on all managed devices.

item.title: CVE-2021-20028 — SonicWall Secure Remote Access (SRA)
item.description: Threat Signal 76. SonicWall Secure Remote Access (SRA) products contain an improper neutralization of a SQL Command leading to SQL injection.

item.title: CVE-2010-4344 — Exim Exim
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Heap-based buffer overflow in the string_vformat function in string.c in Exim before 4.70 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via an SMTP session.

item.title: CVE-2017-6316 — Citrix NetScaler SD-WAN Enterprise, CloudBridge Virtual WAN, and XenMobile Server
item.description: Threat Signal 75. A vulnerability has been identified in the management interface of Citrix NetScaler SD-WAN Enterprise and Standard Edition and Citrix CloudBridge Virtual WAN Edition that could result in an unauthenticated, remote attacker being able to execute arbitrary code as a root user. This vulnerability also affects XenMobile Server.

item.title: CVE-2005-2773 — Hewlett Packard (HP) OpenView Network Node Manager
item.description: Threat Signal 75. HP OpenView Network Node Manager could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands on the system.

item.title: CVE-2020-5135 — SonicWall SonicOS
item.description: Threat Signal 75. A buffer overflow vulnerability in SonicOS allows a remote attacker to cause Denial of Service (DoS) and potentially execute arbitrary code by sending a malicious request to the firewall.

item.title: CVE-2015-1187 — D-Link and TRENDnet Multiple Devices
item.description: Threat Signal 77. The ping tool in multiple D-Link and TRENDnet devices allow remote attackers to perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2022-26143 — Mitel MiCollab, MiVoice Business Express
item.description: Threat Signal 77. A vulnerability has been identified in MiCollab and MiVoice Business Express that may allow a malicious actor to gain unauthorized access to sensitive information and services, cause performance degradations or a denial of service condition on the affected system.

item.title: CVE-2016-10174 — NETGEAR WNR2000v5 Router
item.description: Threat Signal 77. The NETGEAR WNR2000v5 router contains a buffer overflow which can be exploited to achieve remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2015-0311 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 77. Unspecified vulnerability in Adobe Flash Player allows remote attackers to execute code.

item.title: CVE-2017-11317 — Telerik User Interface (UI) for ASP.NET AJAX
item.description: Threat Signal 77. Telerik.Web.UI in Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX allows remote attackers to perform arbitrary file uploads or execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2019-11581 — Atlassian Jira Server and Data Center
item.description: Threat Signal 77. Atlassian Jira Server and Data Center contain a server-side template injection vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2015-4068 — Arcserve Unified Data Protection (UDP)
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Directory traversal vulnerability in Arcserve UDP allows remote attackers to obtain sensitive information or cause a denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2013-1690 — Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird do not properly handle onreadystatechange events in conjunction with page reloading, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) or possibly execute malicious code via a crafted web site.

item.title: CVE-2017-6334 — NETGEAR DGN2200 Devices
item.description: Threat Signal 72. dnslookup.cgi on NETGEAR DGN2200 devices with firmware through 10.0.0.50 allows remote authenticated users to execute arbitrary OS commands

item.title: CVE-2019-12991 — Citrix SD-WAN and NetScaler
item.description: Threat Signal 73. Authenticated Command Injection in Citrix SD-WAN Appliance and NetScaler SD-WAN Appliance.

item.title: CVE-2018-8414 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 73. A remote code execution vulnerability exists when the Windows Shell does not properly validate file paths.

item.title: CVE-2016-7201 — Microsoft Edge
item.description: Threat Signal 74. The Chakra JavaScript scripting engine in Microsoft Edge allows remote attackers to execute remote code or cause a denial of service (memory corruption) via a crafted web site.

item.title: CVE-2016-7200 — Microsoft Edge
item.description: Threat Signal 74. The Chakra JavaScript scripting engine in Microsoft Edge allows remote attackers to execute remote code or cause a denial of service (memory corruption) via a crafted web site.

item.title: CVE-2018-14839 — LG N1A1 NAS
item.description: Threat Signal 78. LG N1A1 NAS 3718.510 is affected by a remote code execution vulnerability.

item.title: CVE-2012-5076 — Oracle Java SE
item.description: Threat Signal 78. The default Java security properties configuration did not restrict access to the com.sun.org.glassfish.external and com.sun.org.glassfish.gmbal packages. An untrusted Java application or applet could use these flaws to bypass Java sandbox restrictions.

item.title: CVE-2015-2419 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 69. JScript in Microsoft Internet Explorer allows remote attackers to execute remote code or cause a denial of service (memory corruption) via a crafted web site.

item.title: CVE-2019-1322 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 70. A privilege escalation vulnerability exists when Windows improperly handles authentication requests. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could run processes in an elevated context.

item.title: CVE-2016-3309 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 70. A privilege escalation vulnerability exists when the Windows kernel fails to properly handle objects in memory. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could run arbitrary code in kernel mode.

item.title: CVE-2018-8440 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 70. An elevation of privilege vulnerability exists when Windows improperly handles calls to Advanced Local Procedure Call (ALPC).

item.title: CVE-2009-1151 — phpMyAdmin phpMyAdmin
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Setup script used to generate configuration can be fooled using a crafted POST request to include arbitrary PHP code in generated configuration file.

item.title: CVE-2019-12989 — Citrix SD-WAN and NetScaler
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Citrix SD-WAN and NetScaler SD-WAN allow SQL Injection.

item.title: CVE-2019-10068 — Kentico Xperience
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Kentico contains a failure to validate security headers. This deserialization can led to unauthenticated remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2019-1003030 — Jenkins Matrix Project Plugin
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Jenkins Matrix Project plugin contains a vulnerability which can allow users to escape the sandbox, opening opportunity to perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2007-3010 — Alcatel OmniPCX Enterprise
item.description: Threat Signal 79. masterCGI in the Unified Maintenance Tool in Alcatel OmniPCX Enterprise Communication Server allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands.

item.title: CVE-2015-5122 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Use-after-free vulnerability in the DisplayObject class in the ActionScript 3 (AS3) implementation in Adobe Flash Player allows remote attackers to execute code or cause a denial-of-service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2015-0313 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Use-after-free vulnerability in Adobe Flash Player allows remote attackers to execute code.

item.title: CVE-2018-10561 — Dasan Gigabit Passive Optical Network (GPON) Routers
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Dasan GPON Routers contain an authentication bypass vulnerability. When combined with CVE-2018-10562, exploitation can allow an attacker to perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2020-25223 — Sophos SG UTM
item.description: Threat Signal 79. A remote code execution vulnerability exists in the WebAdmin of Sophos SG UTM.

item.title: CVE-2015-2502 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows an attacker to execute code or cause a denial-of-service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2014-6324 — Microsoft Kerberos Key Distribution Center (KDC)
item.description: Threat Signal 75. The Kerberos Key Distribution Center (KDC) in Microsoft allows remote authenticated domain users to obtain domain administrator privileges.

item.title: CVE-2015-2426 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 75. A remote code execution vulnerability exists in Microsoft Windows when the Windows Adobe Type Manager Library improperly handles specially crafted OpenType fonts.

item.title: CVE-2017-0037 — Microsoft Edge and Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Microsoft Edge and Internet Explorer have a type confusion vulnerability in mshtml.dll, which allows remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2019-1405 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 72. A privilege escalation vulnerability exists when the Windows UPnP service improperly allows COM object creation.

item.title: CVE-2021-21551 — Dell dbutil Driver
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Dell dbutil driver contains an insufficient access control vulnerability which may lead to escalation of privileges, denial-of-service (DoS), or information disclosure.

item.title: CVE-2020-2509 — QNAP QNAP Network-Attached Storage (NAS)
item.description: Threat Signal 67. QNAP NAS devices contain a command injection vulnerability which could allow attackers to perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-22941 — Citrix ShareFile
item.description: Threat Signal 81. Improper Access Control in Citrix ShareFile storage zones controller may allow an unauthenticated attacker to remotely compromise the storage zones controller.

item.title: CVE-2015-3113 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in Adobe Flash Player allows remote attackers to execute code.

item.title: CVE-2016-1555 — NETGEAR Wireless Access Point (WAP) Devices
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Multiple NETGEAR Wireless Access Point devices allows unauthenticated web pages to pass form input directly to the command-line interface. Exploitation allows for arbitrary code execution.
